motivation: The bounded decomposition of only the three registered old grids exactly reproduces the native maxima and identifies recovery-time resolution, not AUC error, as the stopping component.
proposed_single_rule: Replace outcome-dependent choice among coarse/medium/fine grids with the fixed complete integer episode axis G(T)={0,1,...,T}. T remains determined by the unchanged A95 law on a completely fresh baseline population.

measurement_consequences.recovery: The unchanged K=3 consecutive-checkpoint recovery law now means three adjacent training episodes; no endpoint or recovery-fraction threshold is loosened.
measurement_consequences.auc: The unchanged trapezoidal DeficitAUC uses all adjacent episode observations, rather than interpolating long sparse intervals.
measurement_consequences.late_window_retention: H1=q,H2=T unchanged; its checkpoint-mean formula now includes every integer episode q..T. This changes numerical values and their stability/population-SD margin relative to sparse-grid measurements and is part of the requested approval.
measurement_consequences.grid_guard: The <=0.05 error guard and all axis/source/hash integrity checks remain. With identical full-prefix/full-master-bank arguments, dense-vs-dense discretization error is structurally zero; this is NOT an empirical scientific PASS or treatment benefit.

unchanged.horizon_law: A95 entire healthy/flat suffix through cap576, at least two follow-up episodes; nearest-rank90% retains censored seeds; T=max(ceil(6*q/5),q+2), stop if unidentifiable or T>576.
unchanged.collateral_selection: Unchanged original full32x577 refinement and incidence laws.
unchanged.retention_fixed_construct_witness: Same algebraic same-grid rational-area witness, not fitted to sampled outcomes.
unchanged.spearman: actual/null diagnosis only, never eligibility or ranking
unchanged.selection_order: Original Retention stability then form order; unchanged atomic indivisible F1 result.
unchanged.same_seed_arithmetic_and_join: Chronology, original left-to-right arithmetic and fixed seed-order joins.
unchanged.statistical_claim: Original separated T/P conjunction: FutureUtility benefit, Collateral constraint, Retention persistence/non-inferiority and T-harm constraint; no practical-value/equivalence/zero-harm claim.

tradeoffs.cost: Dense acquisition of every checkpoint already applied to old development data; prospective treatment/confirmation now requires up to577 evaluations per trajectory instead of a selected sparse grid. It may cost materially more; no runtime speedup is promised.
tradeoffs.timing: A new source-bound complete37-key workload timing is required. Old timings are historical only; they cannot certify the new instrument or dense B2 workload.
tradeoffs.remaining_uncertainty: New f_T/f_N/f_C/f_R may still be inadmissible; F1 is not learning-benefit completion. No Retention or treatment effect on any new grid has been evaluated with old curves.

approval.exact_scope: Fixed dense G(T), including its consecutive-episode recovery meaning and q..T checkpoint-mean Retention consequences; otherwise unchanged listed scientific laws.
approval.reply_context: 2026-10-09 reply directly to the exact approval question for fixed every-episode measurement, following explanation of recovery/Retention consequences and cost.
